Hubble Space Telescope visible-light WFPC2/ACS composite, iconic six-prong diffraction spikes on foreground stars, richly saturated nebular emission in hydrogen-alpha red and oxygen-III teal, pillar-and-cloud star-forming regions.

James Webb Space Telescope NIRCam near-infrared composite, distinctive eight-prong diffraction spikes, burnt-amber molecular hydrogen and cobalt-cyan ionized-gas false-color mapping, deeply embedded protostars and first-light galaxies.

Chandra X-ray Observatory pseudo-color composite, purple-magenta and electric-cyan high-energy emission tracing shock fronts and neutron-star coronae, supernova remnant interiors invisible to optical telescopes.
ALMA millimeter-wavelength interferometric image, smooth gradient radio pseudo-color in warm ochre and rust against black, cold molecular cloud cores and protoplanetary disk dust-ring structure.
Event Horizon Telescope 1.3mm VLBI composite, blurred orange-amber emission ring surrounding a perfect coal-black shadow, supermassive black hole accretion disk at galactic nuclei.

Spitzer Space Telescope mid-infrared IRAC composite, characteristic rose-gold and seafoam false-color from 3.6-to-8-micron band mapping, warm dust lanes threading spiral galaxy arms and embedded star clusters.

Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope wide-field near-infrared mosaic, vast degree-scale survey frames teeming with resolved galaxies, uniform depth and low distortion across enormous sky patches, large-scale cosmic structure mapping.
GALEX Galaxy Evolution Explorer UV composite, electric blue-white ultraviolet glow tracing hot young O-type stars, galaxy disks showing spiral arm star-formation rings invisible in optical imaging.
Hinode X-Ray Telescope soft X-ray solar image, high-contrast monochromatic silver-white coronal loops arching over active regions, million-degree solar corona structure and flare ribbon detail.

Solar Dynamics Observatory AIA extreme-ultraviolet composite, false-color gold-and-teal 171-to-304-angstrom band imaging, solar prominence filaments and coronal hole dark regions on the full solar disk.

Subaru Telescope Hyper Suprime-Cam visible-light wide-field mosaic, exquisitely sharp ground-adaptive-optics color balance, gravitational lens arcs and rich galaxy cluster foreground-background superposition.

ESO Very Large Telescope MUSE integral-field optical composite, emission-line velocity-mapped nebulae color-coded by Doppler shift, detailed ionization-front structure in planetary nebulae and supernova remnants.

XMM-Newton X-ray Observatory EPIC pseudo-color image, softer and more diffuse than Chandra, gold-orange low-energy and blue high-energy bands blended, hot intracluster gas permeating galaxy cluster halos.
VLA Very Large Array radio continuum image, smooth contour-mapped jet lobes in false-color blue-to-red gradient, relativistic plasma jets extending megaparsecs from active galactic nuclei.
Pan-STARRS PS1 visible-light all-sky survey mosaic, photometrically calibrated natural color, faint high-latitude cirrus and stellar stream filaments threading the Milky Way halo over wide fields.

Keck Observatory NIRC2 adaptive-optics near-infrared image, laser-guide-star corrected diffraction-limited resolution, crowded Galactic Center stellar orbits and dusty torus silhouettes around embedded sources.

Hubble Space Telescope UV-optical ultraviolet ACS/SBC composite, blue-ultraviolet Wolf-Rayet stellar winds and hot subdwarf populations standing out against older red stellar halos in nearby galaxies.
Spitzer Space Telescope MIPS 24-micron far-infrared image, monochromatic deep-red thermal dust glow, warm interstellar cirrus and starburst galaxy nuclei saturating the center of the frame.
ALMA Band 7 submillimeter dust-continuum image, ultra-high-resolution disk ring and gap structure in false-color amber rings on black, protoplanetary disk architecture around young T-Tauri stars.

Chandra X-ray Observatory color-composite supernova remnant, concentric rings of blue synchrotron and red thermal bremsstrahlung emission, expanding shock boundary razor-sharp against a clean black background.

Hubble Ultra Deep Field ACS multi-epoch visible composite, thousands of galaxies at every redshift packed into a tiny sky patch, faint smeared ellipticals and blue irregular dwarfs at cosmological distances.

GALEX Deep Imaging Survey far-UV and near-UV two-band composite, diffuse blue-violet ultraviolet continuum revealing ram-pressure-stripped star-forming tails trailing cluster galaxies invisible in ground-based optical data.
ESO VLT SPHERE near-infrared coronagraphic image, dark central occulting mask blocking the host star, scattered-light disk structure in pale gold showing dust rings and companion point sources.

Hinode Solar Optical Telescope G-band visible image, extreme granulation texture across the solar photosphere, dark intergranular lanes and bright facular points surrounding sunspot umbra-penumbra structure.

James Webb Space Telescope MIRI mid-infrared composite, distinctive soft-edged diffraction pattern without sharp spikes, deep burgundy and viridian false-color tracing polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon emission in galactic starburst regions.
